headline: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol launches with aggressive pricing push via Devin
body: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model is now available through Devin with a 70% introductory discount, signaling accelerated competition in the enterprise AI market. For healthcare organizations, this pricing move forces immediate ROI recalculation on existing AI vendor contracts and integration roadmaps. The velocity and multi-platform coverage indicate this is a significant market shift that will pressure current healthcare AI implementations around clinical documentation, diagnostic support, and prior authorization workflows. Healthcare CIOs and chief medical information officers should reassess their model selection criteria now, as pricing compression at this scale typically triggers vendor renegotiations. This development also highlights the fragmentation risk in healthcare AI stacks as multiple competing models with different pricing structures demand careful governance and cost allocation.
